reason: TUTORIAL Example 1 runs demo.py photorealistic style transfer with a bundled 33MB checkpoint; --cuda 0 and --fast (OpenCV guided filter) allow CPU-only operation on small images.
demo: TUTORIAL.md Example 1 / README: python demo.py --fast --output_image_path results/example1.png (run with --cuda 0)
goal: Get `python demo.py --cuda 0 --fast --no_post --content_image_path A --style_image_path B --output_image_path OUT` working on CPU only, using the bundled PhotoWCTModels/photo_wct.pth, on small PNG content and style images. The repo targets old PyTorch/CUDA and imports cupy at module load (smooth_filter.py), so the code and environment must be adapted to run without a GPU. It must write a stylized image of the same size as the content image.
check: The hidden test runs demo.py on CPU with generated content and style images and verifies a non-blank output image of the content image's size that differs from the content.
